run_vlc_evaluation: run the VLC checklist evaluation on a CLIP model using run_vlc_on_model
score_vlc_aggregate: aggregate and print VLC evaluation scores from result JSON files using score_vlc
run_vlc_baseline: run the VLC evaluation on the openai clip-vit-base-patch32 baseline model
run_vlc_swig_only: run score_vlc with swig_only to filter scores to SWIG datasets only
review_vlc_yaml_configs: review the ATTRIBUTE_YAML, OBJECT_YAML, RELATION_SPATIAL_YAML, and RELATION_ACTION_YAML config templates
